research_outcome: RESEARCHED_INCONCLUSIVE — earlier New Kingdom Amun-temple captive/enslaved labour is well supported and near-anchor Amun-linked subordinate/service/property relations are documented, but Temple-of-Amun slave/unfree labour at or around 1000 BCE is not securely established
bounded_proposition: The Amun institution at Karnak remained active around 1000 BCE in a Third Intermediate Period environment that included slavery, alienable persons and perpetual service relations; reviewed near-anchor evidence does not securely identify a human slave/unfree workforce belonging to or working for the Temple of Amun itself.
required_abstention: Do not infer New Kingdom continuity; bAk=slave; foreign/Asiatic=slave; Amun-priestly family property=Temple-of-Amun labour; shabti terminology=human practice; prevalence; or practice geometry.
evidence_locus: New Kingdom Amun/Karnak captive labour; Twenty-first-Dynasty Great Amun enclosure/oracular texts; Amun high-priestly family property transactions; broader Third Intermediate Egypt.
inference_extent: Earlier target-specific positive and near-anchor institution-linked context only; selected-anchor Temple-of-Amun slave/unfree-labour status remains unknown.
law_practice_note: Third Intermediate slavery/alienable service is documented in Egypt and Amun-linked property law, but no exact-anchor Karnak labour/status record securely establishes Temple-of-Amun slave practice.
network_territorial_note: No external/network dimension is promoted; war-captive acquisition belongs primarily to the earlier New Kingdom context and is not projected through time.
historical_terms: bꜣk.w; bꜣk; ḥm; mrt; captives; perpetual services
category_mapping_note: Egyptian servant/slave terminology is polysemous. Near-anchor bꜣk.w in the Banishment Stela is kept as servants/priests/political exiles rather than normalized to slave; New Kingdom captive/enslaved categories remain earlier context.
language_access_limitations: English/French/Spanish specialist synthesis and translated Egyptian texts used; Egyptian terms were not independently retranslated. No exhaustive hieratic/Demotic or unpublished Karnak archive search.
geometry_claim_role: Institution/site identity only; archaeological extent is not evidence of slavery extent.
geometry_unresolved_note: Ancient Amun estate boundaries and any slavery/coercion practice extent are unresolved; no practice polygon authorized.
